Definition: from G852; to render unapparent, i.e. (actively) consume (becloud), or (passively) disappear (be destroyed):-- corrupt, disfigure, perish, vanish away.
BiblicalUsage: To make disappear, to consume — the fading of earthly treasure before moth and rust, the rich man's life vanishing like a vapour, and the scoffers in the synagogue told to behold and perish. The word destroys what it touches, whether treasure, life, or the proud.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that this word preaches the sermon itself: what I store on earth will vanish, and what I store in heaven will not. James calls my life a vapour, and I believe him — which is why I want it spent on what lasts.
RelatedPeople: Jesus; Paul; James, Brother of Jesus
